description: This file defines internal interfaces related to the Orleans runtime's consistent ring provider, including methods for retrieving responsibility ranges, subscribing/unsubscribing to range change events, and determining the primary target silo based on a key.

classes.name: IConsistentRingProvider
classes.description: An internal interface for a consistent ring provider managing silo responsibility ranges and event subscriptions.

classes.name: IRingRangeListener
classes.description: An internal interface for listening to range change notifications in the consistent ring.

methods.name: GetMyRange
methods.description: Retrieves the responsibility range of the current silo.

methods.name: SubscribeToRangeChangeEvents
methods.description: Subscribes an observer to receive range change notifications.

methods.name: UnSubscribeFromRangeChangeEvents
methods.description: Unsubscribes an observer from receiving range change notifications.

methods.name: GetPrimaryTargetSilo
methods.description: Determines the primary silo responsible for a given key based on consistent hashing.

methods.name: RangeChangeNotification
methods.description: Notifies the listener of a change in the range, indicating whether the range increased.
